people.name: Azariah
people.line: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

people.name: Hananiah
people.line: One of Daniel's three friends in Babylon.

people.name: Mishael
people.line: A Jewish exile in Babylon, friend of Daniel.

translations.web: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
translations.bsb: The chief official gave them new names: To Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
translations.kjv: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abednego.
translations.asv: And the prince of the eunuchs gave names unto them: unto Daniel he gave the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abed-nego.
